soru: En fazla harcama yapan üçüncü müşteriyi getir.
sql:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_price) AS toplam_harcama
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o
ON c.id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY toplam_harcama DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2;
